lessons.correction: Stabilize then develop, increase production, maintain ground strength.
lessons.mistake: Risky aggression or overexpansion without sufficient army strength or defense.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when map control or opponent intentions are clearer.
lessons.title: Stabilize before expanding
lessons.when: Early-midgame, own ground army with heavy production and tech, opponent ground with light air.
lessons.why: Ensure safety before expanding further, leveraging tech advantage.

lessons.correction: Increase air presence, strengthen ground army, continue tech and production.
lessons.mistake: Over-investing in air without proper scouting, or neglecting upgrades.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when opponent tech or air presence changes.
lessons.title: Add air flexibility while maintaining ground
lessons.when: Midgame, own ground army with heavy production and tech, opponent heavy ground with possible air.
lessons.why: Maintain ground dominance while adding air flexibility to counter potential tech switches.

lessons.correction: Increase defense, continue tech, strengthen ground army.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting anti-air, as Mutalisks can harass.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition is known.
lessons.title: Prepare defense for late-game
lessons.when: Late-midgame, own heavy ground army, opponent heavy ground with possible air.
lessons.why: Prepare for potential late-game engagements with solid defense.
